description: Search current one-way campervan relocation deals in Europe from Roadsurfer, IndyCampers and Imoova. Filter by pickup city, drop-off city, travel window and provider; every filter is optional. A city matches every pickup or drop-off city within 60 km of it, and must be a name list_cities returns. A deal matches the travel window when its own window overlaps it. Results are sorted by start date and capped by limit; total is the full match count. Each deal has the provider's booking link and a link that opens the map on its pickup city, and the answer has map_url, which opens the map on the searched pickup city, or else the drop-off city, for the requested dates. Read-only: it does not book anything or create alerts. E-mail alerts for new deals are set up on the website. Data comes from the providers a few times a day, so a deal may be gone when the link is opened.

end_date.description: Last day of the travel window, YYYY-MM-DD. Keeps deals whose own window starts on or before it.

from.description: Pickup city, for example "Amsterdam". Matches pickup cities within 60 km. Leave out for any pickup city.

limit.description: Most deals to return, 1 to 100. Default 25.

providers.description: Only these providers: roadsurfer (Roadsurfer), indiecampers (IndyCampers), imoova (Imoova). Leave out for all three.

start_date.description: First day of the travel window, YYYY-MM-DD. Keeps deals whose own window ends on or after it.

to.description: Drop-off city, for example "Barcelona". Matches drop-off cities within 60 km. Leave out for any drop-off city.

name: search_deals

booking_url.description: The deal on the provider's own site.

end_date.description: Last day of the deal's window.

map_url.description: Camper Rally Map opened on the pickup city for these dates.

start_date.description: First day of the deal's window.

map_url.description: Camper Rally Map opened on the searched pickup city, or else the drop-off city, for the requested dates.

title: Search relocation deals
